metric_definitions.D: Mean across users of recent-minus-older mean normalized replacement rank effect. Draws are averaged within user first. Unavailable for incomplete frozen panels; not validation HR@10 gain.
metric_definitions.accounting: Elapsed synchronized wall time includes manifest generation, sampled probes, scoring, and summaries; it is a conservative local diagnostic cap checked before encodes, not GPU event time or a replacement for host shared-budget accounting. An in-flight encode or CPU summary may finish beyond the cap.
metric_definitions.aggregation: Replicates averaged within each user, users averaged within each category, then all four required categories equally. Missing categories produce null macro entries; truncation suppresses the macro entirely.
metric_definitions.ci95: 10000 paired user-bootstrap resamples per category from independent category streams rooted at seed 0; percentile interval. At most 32 training users/category. Conditional on fitted model, selected users, candidates and replacements; excludes training-seed variability and adaptive-selection correction. Singleton intervals are degenerate.
metric_definitions.data_scope: Final public training interaction is the target and preceding retained history is the prefix. These targets may already have been trained on. No held-out labels, ratings, review text, item categories, prices, stores, or simulator traits are used.
metric_definitions.embedding_collapse_score: (mean off-diagonal cosine + 1)/2 on up to 2048 nonpadding item embeddings, isolated seed 42. Directional alignment only; 0.5 means mean cosine zero. Does not measure recommendation diversity or embedding rank.
metric_definitions.experiment_status: Training exposes baseline and fixed later-target BCE objectives through SASREC_VARIANT; one four-category fit per invocation. Diagnostic policy choices require all four complete panels and explicit model.variant='baseline'. This identifies the declared objective, not checkpoint equivalence or prospective timing. Matching manifests are keyed by history, norms and objective; a variant-generated manifest is a separate descriptive audit and cannot replace a frozen baseline panel. No experiment launcher, shared budget ledger or host-outcome ingestion is implemented here; validation policy values and correspondence remain unavailable until externally measured. Earlier inspected evidence remains retrospective.
metric_definitions.feature_cosine: Cosine between final-position features; null when either feature has zero norm.
metric_definitions.hit10_change: Perturbed indicator(target rank <= 10) minus original indicator, within the same 100 diagnostic candidates.
metric_definitions.normalized_rank_effect: (edited target rank - unchanged target rank)/99 within the same target plus 99 unique diagnostic negatives; positive means harm.
metric_definitions.perturbations: Recent replaces the penultimate occupied item; older replaces the earliest. Final item and occupied positions stay fixed. Five distinct replacements are sampled from the closest 50 eligible items, or all if fewer. Eligibility matches presence elsewhere in prefix, excluding original and target. Squared standardized log1p training frequency and baseline embedding norm determine proximity. Shortages and residuals are recorded. Swap exchanges these two positions while preserving the item multiset.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_category_breakdown: Unsupported: item categories are unavailable. Empty category lists are not evidence of no category effects.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_count: Number of valid sampled positive-negative positions; missing estimates are null.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_mean: Mean positive-minus-sampled-negative logit over nonpadding pairs from at most ten loader batches and 256 sequences, further limited to reserve the frozen paired panel. In-sample, dependent on loader sampling, and scoped to the primary view rather than a four-category macro.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_p10: Nearest-rank lower tenth percentile of sampled margins.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_neg_beats_pos_rate: Fraction of sampled margins strictly below zero.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_small_margin_rate: Fraction of sampled margins below 0.5; raw score scale affects this measurement.
metric_definitions.position_control: Identity replacement retains occupied positions and padding; swap preserves the multiset. Neither independently identifies absolute-position effects, and both can induce unrealistic transitions. Repetition presence does not preserve exact multiplicity.
metric_definitions.rank_change: Perturbed target rank minus original rank; positive is worse. Diagnostic ranks use score descending, item ID ascending ties.
metric_definitions.top10_overlap: Size of original/perturbed top-ten set intersection divided by ten.
metric_definitions.validation: Diagnostic candidates and tie rules are independent of the pinned host evaluator. No host users, exclusions, ranking semantics, or splits are changed. Sensitivity and bootstrap intervals do not establish validation improvements.

diagnostic_deployment_policy.status: unavailable: incomplete panel or baseline objective not explicitly identified
diagnostic_deployment_policy.timing: Frozen before this probe's results; prior validation exposure unknown. Apply only measurements made on the matched baseline, not the variant
diagnostic_deployment_policy.validation_status: Matched pinned host outcomes have not been supplied; local checkpoint metrics are not substituted

position_preserving_control.limitations: Relative recency and absolute position are not independently identified; matching does not guarantee realistic transitions
position_preserving_control.preserved: shape, padding, occupied positions, final conditioning item, candidates; no token deletion or timestamp edit
position_preserving_control.status: identity replacement and recent/older swap implemented

history_perturbations.routing_status: unsupported: provide dataset_name or an explicit diagnostic_views mapping; routes cannot be inferred from local item IDs

intervention_experiment.category_analysis: Spearman with average tie ranks; undefined for constants; enumerate all 24 diagnostic assignments for one-sided association and policy-gain correspondence
intervention_experiment.limitations: Four heterogeneous categories; exchangeability questionable; minimum permutation fraction 1/24; one variant cannot establish general diagnostic usefulness
intervention_experiment.missingness: No host outcomes or remaining-budget ledger were supplied; policy values, validation intervals, association and permutation fractions remain unavailable
intervention_experiment.paired_validation_analysis: only if host exposes paired hits: discordant counts and 10000 seed-0 within-category paired bootstrap resamples
intervention_experiment.policy: variant iff baseline D > 0; ties select baseline
intervention_experiment.prediction: larger baseline D predicts larger variant-minus-baseline category HR@10 gain
intervention_experiment.preregistration_timing: before this probe; prior validation exposure unknown
intervention_experiment.status: host outcomes unavailable; one selected objective is trained per invocation
intervention_experiment.stop_rule: host shared 43200 GPU-second cap, including all eight fits, diagnostics, debugging and failures; no automatic additional fits
